observed.error: invalid planner action: 'ascii' codec can't encode characters in position 7-10: ordinal not in range(128)

root_cause.description: The masked credential input contained non-ASCII characters. httpx encodes HTTP header values as ASCII and raised UnicodeEncodeError while constructing the Authorization header, before transport execution.
root_cause.local_reproduction: httpx.Headers with an Authorization value containing four non-ASCII characters produces the same exception and position range; an ASCII test value is accepted.

interpretation.reason: No request reached the provider and no planner action or tool trace was produced. The raw 0/24 is an infrastructure failure count, not an estimate of agent task success.
